apps.system_instruction: [IMPORTANT FOR AI: Do not generate any image yet if I have not attached my reference photo(s). If there are no photos attached to this prompt, please kindly reply with: "Please upload your photo(s) first!"]
apps.base_prompt1: Using the attached photo as a reference, generate a photo of a couple together. Keep their original facial features exactly the same,
apps.base_prompt2: Using the two attached photos as references, combine these two individuals together as a couple. Keep their original facial features exactly the same,
apps.how_to_use:
🚀 How to Use WeddingPrompt:

  1. Pick a Style: Browse our gallery and choose the AI wedding aesthetic you love.
  2. Choose Photo Option: Select whether you will use 1 photo (you both together) or 2 separate photos.
  3. Generate & Copy: Tap "Generate Prompt", then click "Copy Prompt" to save the secret text formula.
  4. Open AI Generator: Open your favorite AI tool (like ChatGPT, Gemini, or Copilot).
  5. Upload & Paste: 📎 Upload your reference photo(s) first using the attachment button, then paste the copied prompt and send!

💡 Pro Tip: For the most beautiful AI results, make sure the faces in your uploaded photos are clear, well-lit, and not covered by objects!
